title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
description:
arXiv:2610.12567v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Prior research on learning from humans often requires real human demonstrations. But advances in video generation models offer a new paradigm: we can now prompt these generators to make synthetic videos of the task. On the plus side, these synthetic videos take place in the robot's current environment, and do not require actual human teaching.
